scope: Exact mathematical falsification of recovered printed specifications; no organism import, mutation, native build or physical hardware test

checks.subject: April v4.0 carry formula and v5.0.1 carry function contain an extra minus one
checks.limitation: This falsifies the printed formula for the stated balanced digits; no claim that deployed native/HDL uses it. With incoming carry the same offset error persists.

checks.subject: Printed numerical energy barrier2.37 contradicts its own coefficients
checks.limitation: Arithmetic substitution only. This does not validate the proposed barrier law or physical constants.

checks.subject: Subtracting individual constraint ranks double-counts dependent constraints
checks.limitation: For these linear equality constraints the correct rank is the stacked independent rank. Nonlinear geometry requires its own demonstrated conditions; no replacement L6 law is invented.

checks.subject: One sum-parity constraint cannot uniquely locate and correct any unknown single-trit error
checks.limitation: If the failed position is independently known, the other four trits can reconstruct that erasure. The counterexample concerns the blanket unknown-error correction claim.

checks.subject: Hermitian evolution with additive injection does not generally conserve norm
checks.limitation: Norm preservation holds for the homogeneous Hermitian evolution, not arbitrary forcing. A valid open-system balance must be supplied; renormalization would hide the input balance.

checks.subject: v0.4 Crank–Nicolson forcing term disagrees with its stated differential equation
checks.limitation: For i*hbar*dpsi/dt=H*psi+J with constant J, the forcing increment is -i*dt*J/hbar. No product equation was edited.

checks.subject: The claimed three levels for ceil(log3(32)) is incorrect
checks.limitation: This only corrects the stated tree-depth arithmetic; it does not validate the physical per-level latency or the carry implementation.

checks.subject: Integer folding quotient truncation is not always the nearest finite balanced-ternary approximation
checks.limitation: Truncating an already exact balanced-ternary expansion has a different tail-bound property. The printed divide-after-scaling algorithm truncates an integer quotient, so that property does not prove its claim. Actual HDL must be traced independently.

checks.subject: Independent redundant-digit normalization omits incoming carry when claimed as final canonical digits
checks.limitation: Keeping the carry vector as a separate redundant representation preserves value; it does not establish a fully normalized result in the asserted two independent passes. Further carry incorporation must be specified and bounded.

checks.subject: Unforced time-independent Hermitian evolution does not itself minimize energy
checks.limitation: This exact solution remains above the minimum. Dissipative TAL and conservative Psi laws need an explicit coupling/open-system balance; one cannot call them equivalent because both use a field.
